HOW IT WORKS

The same loop, every day

Log what happened, see what still matters, and let the coach pick the highest-leverage next move.

Log the real meal

Search, scan, snap a photo, or add a custom plate without turning dinner into data entry.

Ask the coach

Get a next move based on what you already ate, what you still need, and how your day is going.

Watch the pattern

Progress reads like direction over time, not a pass/fail scoreboard for one imperfect day.

PRODUCT

Built for messy real life

FuelWell keeps the practical surfaces close together: food, coach, workouts, recipes, groceries, recovery, and progress.

The point is not perfect tracking.

The point is making the next clean choice obvious enough to act on when your day is already moving.

Daily targets

Calories and macros sized from setup.

Photo estimates

Draft meals from a plate image.

Barcode lookup

Fast grocery and packaged-food logging.

Recipes

Meals that respect goals and preferences.

Workouts

Suggestions that fit energy and recovery.

Food rules

Diet and allergy context stays attached.

COACH

Answers that can carry structure

The coach can respond with practical plans, comparisons, lists, tables, meal ideas, and progress explanations right in the chat.

I have 1,400 calories and 102g protein left. What should dinner be?

Build dinner around lean protein first. Chicken quinoa bowl or salmon with sweet potatoes both close the gap cleanly.

I only have 20 minutes to move. Is that worth logging?

Yes. Pick a low-impact full-body circuit and keep intensity moderate so tomorrow still works.

Why did my weight jump after a good day?

Likely water, sodium, stress, or sleep. Your trend matters more than one weigh-in.

START IN TWO MINUTES

Get a starting plan, then let the app adapt from real logs.
